name: share-01
title: Share 01
description: A Share dialog for one item — invite people and teams with one access level, people with access and why, general access in the item's space, and a view-only public link; a Dialog on wide screens, a bottom Sheet on phones.

meta.whenToUse: Share a record, page or meeting with people and teams, set its general access and turn a public link on or off.
meta.whenNotToUse: Manage a space's or team's members as a page — compose DataList with PeoplePicker and PermissionMenu.
